      Dividend per share for 3Q26

      Full 3Q coverage

      Latest news, views and stories

      Businesses resilient amid energy pressures, HSBC survey finds

      Energy has emerged as the leading cost pressure facing global firms, but the majority remain confident in their ability to grow international trade over the next two years, according to our Global Trade Pulse Survey 2026.

      Read more

      From fossil fuels to renewables – a transition story

      Learn how ACEN, an energy company and our client, went from being a fossil fuel plant operator to a renewables champion in less than a decade.

      Read more

      Mastermind: Digital assets and currencies

      Daragh Maher, Head of Digital Asset Research at HSBC, explores the future of finance and money – and explains why trust remains a vital currency.

      Discover more stories from HSBC

      We’re the ‘World’s Best Transaction Bank’

      The recognition in Euromoney’s Transaction Banking Awards 2026 demonstrates our progress in building a more connected, client-led and internationally differentiated transaction bank.

      Read more

      The Right Wave

      Watch our new brand film – and find out how the concept behind it progressed from drawing board to surfboard.

      Find out more

      Retirement targets jump 20% as life stages overlap, HSBC survey finds

      Affluent individuals believe they need 20% more money to retire than they did a year ago.

      Read more

      More from HSBC

      Your ambition belongs here

      Starting out, stepping up, or switching paths, at HSBC you can build a career with purpose. We’re proud to be people-first, impact-driven, always learning and constantly innovating.

      Find out more

      Our customers

      Customers the world over know us and trust us, often over generations. They value our deep international network, expertise, and focus on their future needs.
